data: Which of the following are true about the data displayed in the figure?

The graph shows the frequencies of the most frequent 100 words in a corpus of length 1 million and vocabulary of size 56,000. The y-axis represents word frequency on a logarithmic scale, ranging from 1 to 100,000. The x-axis represents the rank of the words, starting from the most frequent at the left and decreasing towards the right. The line is relatively flat for the lower ranks but drops sharply for higher ranks, indicating a long tail distribution where a few words have very high frequencies while many words have much lower frequencies. The step width increases as we move to the right, meaning there are fewer distinct frequencies for higher-ranked words. This suggests a power-law distribution, where a small number of words dominate the frequency spectrum.
